title: Network Economies
coreMove: Ask whether each added user makes the product more valuable for other users within a bounded network.
sourcePressure: Network economies exist when the value to one customer rises as more customers use the product. The source stresses winner-take-all pressure, boundedness, decisive early product, and complement effects without turning every audience or platform into a network.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Network economies mean having many users, a community, or a social feature.

sourceAnchors.name: Facebook
sourceAnchors.detail: the source sidecar uses Facebook to show a personal interaction network whose boundary differs from professional interaction
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Facebook can grow strong inside personal interaction without proving that every other network must collapse into it.

sourceAnchors.name: LinkedIn
sourceAnchors.detail: the source sidecar pairs LinkedIn with Facebook to show that different network character can let strong networks coexist
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: LinkedIn survives as a reminder that the purpose of the network sets the boundary of the power.
